assumptions: two-term recurrences G_(k+1) = p G_k + q G_(k-1), p,q in 1..3, several initial values G_1; three-term recurrences; geometric sequences as control
all triples a, b, c in [1, 22]
meta.falsification: Associative cases other than Knuth's (G = Fibonacci, s = 2) refute H-C08-1.
meta.hypothesis: H-C08-1 (inventor's guess): Knuth's Fibonacci product is an isolated miracle - for other recurrences or shifts associativity fails.
meta.methodology: Exhaustive check of (a o b) o c = a o (b o c) on the cube [1,22]^3 for every (G, s); record the first failure (lexicographic) and the failure rate.
meta.question: For which base sequences G and index shifts s is the digit-convolution ('circle') product associative?
meta.title: Associativity atlas of circle products a o b = sum d_i(a) d_j(b) G_(i+j+s)
